The labels must be exactly the seven derived from the pod's name and owner, with egress=allowlist.
Only the log-exclusion and egress-bandwidth annotations are allowed.
Browser pods are bare, with no owners or finalizers.
The pod's fixed fields (service account, no token, hostname, priority, deadline, grace) don't match.
The pod must run in its own user namespace (hostUsers false).
The pod's security context must be uid 1001 with the expected seccomp profile, and nothing more.
The pod sets a field browser pods never use (placement, host namespaces, extra containers, ...).
The tolerations must be exactly not-ready and unreachable for 60 seconds.
One container, named browser, running an allowed image by digest.
The container can't set a command, arguments, hooks or other inputs.
The environment must be exactly the eight literal values, matching the pod and the parameters.
The ports must be vnc 6080 and probe 8080, with no host ports.
Each probe is an HTTP GET of /livez or /readyz on the probe port.
The resources must be the fleet's, memory request equal to its limit.
The container must drop every capability, keep its root read-only, and override nothing.
The termination message comes from /dev/termination-log only.
The mounts must be /tmp, /dev/shm and the hub token, read-only, with no sub-paths.
The volumes must be the two memory scratch dirs and the hub token (audience waitlist-agent, at most 10 minutes).
